home.hero_tagline: A therapeutic massage method born of reflexology and visceral osteopathy — anatomically grounded, taught for thirty years.
home.hero_founder: Institute led by Guy Boitout, co-designed with Jean-Pierre Vadala.
home.what_title_html: The body, mapped onto the foot and the occiput
home.what_body: R.O.P. rests on a three-dimensional cartography of the body projected, in fetal position, onto the plantar surface of the foot and the back of the head. This dual reading — somatic and autonomic, podal and occipital — guides a precise reflex stimulation. The method is anatomically rigorous, adjacent to visceral osteopathy, and practised exclusively by trained professionals.
home.heritage_intro: R.O.P. is not an isolated invention: it extends a heritage that crosses Eunice Ingham's reflexology with Jean-Pierre Barral's visceral osteopathy.

heritage_events.title: Eunice Ingham
heritage_events.body: Modern foot reflexology is formalised in the United States: the foot as a mirror of the body.

heritage_events.title: Jean-Pierre Barral
heritage_events.body: Visceral osteopathy is established in France: the viscera have their own manual reading.

heritage_events.title: Guy Boitout & Jean-Pierre Vadala
heritage_events.body: Two osteopaths meet and decide to cross reflexology with the visceral approach. R.O.P. is born.

heritage_events.title: 3D cartography
heritage_events.body: The three-dimensional representation of the body on the foot and occiput is consolidated and taught.

heritage_events.title: 3 books, 70+ practitioners
heritage_events.body: Three books published by Elsevier-Masson; a network of certified practitioners in France, Spain and Luxembourg.

home.tracks_title_html: Are you a professional, or looking for a practitioner?
home.tracks_train_body: A 12-day foundation course, a catalogue of clinical post-graduate modules, and the Institute's certification. Reserved for motivated health and wellbeing professionals.
home.tracks_directory_body: A network of reflexologists, osteopaths, physiotherapists and nurses trained in R.O.P., across France, Spain and Luxembourg.
home.credibility_body: The R.O.P. Institute is accredited for continuing education (no. 24450434645). It collaborates with the principal professional federations of reflexology and osteopathy.
home.lead_body: Training calendar, new post-graduate modules, research, publications. A short letter, a few times a year. You can unsubscribe at any time.
